Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Unstable Connection / Disconnect Loop]* 🟡

This usually happens with a locked config or battery optimization killing the app.

✅ Steps to fix:
1️⃣ Enter server details *manually* inside the app instead of using a locked file.
2️⃣ Settings → Apps → HTTP Custom → Battery → set to *Unrestricted*.
3️⃣ Toggle Airplane Mode on/off and reconnect.
4️⃣ If still failing, download a fresh config from *www.vpn-config.online* 📂

responses:
Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Stuck on Connecting]* 🔴

HTTP Custom cannot be force-stopped using its own button while it is still trying to connect.

✅ Fix:
1️⃣ Toggle *Mobile Data or Wi-Fi OFF* for a few seconds → turn it back on — this forces the connection attempt to stop.
2️⃣ If the app is frozen: Settings → Apps → HTTP Custom → *Force Stop* → reopen the app.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Hotspot / Tethering Setup]* 📡

✅ Steps:
1️⃣ Connect HTTP Custom first until you see *CONNECTED*.
2️⃣ Then enable your Hotspot or USB Tethering.
3️⃣ Check the app log for the proxy IP and port.

📌 Default proxy addresses:
• *Hotspot:* 192.168.43.1 : 7071
• *USB Tethering:* 192.168.42.129 : 7071

On the connecting device, set the proxy manually to those details and you're good to go!

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[SocksIP Connection Issue]* 🟡

✅ Try these steps:
1️⃣ Clear the app cache: Settings → Apps → SocksIP → Storage → *Clear Cache*.
2️⃣ Download the latest config from *www.vpn-config.online* and re-import.
3️⃣ Toggle Airplane Mode on/off to refresh your IP.
4️⃣ Make sure battery optimization is set to *Unrestricted* for SocksIP.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Invalid Stream Header — Config Deleted Bug]* 🔴

This is a known SocksIP bug where the app throws an 'Invalid Stream Header' error after import and deletes the config.

✅ Workaround:
1️⃣ Re-download the latest config from *www.vpn-config.online*.
2️⃣ Re-import and connect *immediately* — do not close the app.
3️⃣ Keep SocksIP running in the background; fully closing it can trigger the bug again.
4️⃣ If it keeps happening, uninstall and reinstall SocksIP.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[DNS Tunnel / DNSTT Crash]* 🔴

This is a crash bug in older SocksIP versions.

✅ Fix:
1️⃣ Update SocksIP to the latest version from our website or Play Store.
2️⃣ If DNS Tunnel keeps crashing, switch your tunnel mode to *SSH* or *WebSocket (WS)* as a stable alternative.
3️⃣ Clear app cache: Settings → Apps → SocksIP → Storage → *Clear Cache*, then restart.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Disconnects Immediately After Connecting]* 🟡

This is a known regression bug in a recent SocksIP update.

✅ Fix:
1️⃣ Settings → Apps → SocksIP → Battery → set to *Unrestricted*.
2️⃣ Clear cache and re-import the config from *www.vpn-config.online*.
3️⃣ Try switching tunnel mode (e.g. SSH → WebSocket or UDP).
4️⃣ If still failing, download a previous stable version from *Uptodown.com* while waiting for a developer fix.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[ZiVPN Keeps Disconnecting]* 🟡

✅ Try these steps:
1️⃣ Settings → Apps → ZiVPN → Battery → set to *Unrestricted* ← most common cause!
2️⃣ Switch tunneling protocol — try *V2Ray* or *SSH via WebSocket*.
3️⃣ Toggle Airplane Mode on/off and reconnect.
4️⃣ Try a different server region.
5️⃣ Re-download a fresh config from *www.vpn-config.online* 📂

📌 *Note:* ZiVPN is currently under MAINTENANCE — check the status board for updates!

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[ZiVPN UDP Not Working]* 🟡

Two known causes:

📌 *Old Android (Android 6 and below):* UDP tunneling fails to route traffic on older Android versions. Switch to *SSH* or *V2Ray/VMess* mode instead.

📌 *Server-side issue:* Some ZiVPN UDP servers (e.g. South Africa) are reported down. Switch to a different server region or use custom server credentials.

📌 ZiVPN is currently under maintenance — monitor the status board!

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[ZiVPN Config File Not Working]* 🔴

Possible causes:
1️⃣ *Expired config* — Re-download from *www.vpn-config.online*. Always check the expiry date on the status board!
2️⃣ *Wrong source* — Only use official config files from our website. Third-party configs may be outdated.
3️⃣ *Version mismatch* — If ZiVPN was recently updated, re-download the config to match.
4️⃣ *Permission issue* — Settings → Apps → ZiVPN → Permissions → ensure VPN permission is granted.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[VPN Permission Not Granted]* 🔴

All VPN apps require your phone to grant VPN permission before they can work.

✅ Fix:
1️⃣ Open ZiVPN — tap *OK/Allow* on the *'Connection Request'* pop-up.
2️⃣ If you denied it: Settings → Apps → ZiVPN → Permissions → enable VPN.
3️⃣ Also check: Settings → Network & Internet → VPN — make sure ZiVPN is not blocked.
4️⃣ Restart the app and try connecting again.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Battery Optimization Killing VPN]* 🔋

Your phone's battery saver is shutting down the VPN app when your screen turns off. This is one of the most common disconnection causes on Android!

✅ Fix:
1️⃣ Settings → Apps → *[Your VPN App]* → Battery → set to *Unrestricted*.
2️⃣ Settings → Battery → Battery Saver → turn it *OFF* or exclude your VPN app.
3️⃣ For Xiaomi/MIUI users: also check *Security → Battery* and disable power restrictions for the VPN app.

responses:
Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Connected But No Internet]* 🟡

The VPN tunnel is up but traffic isn't routing through correctly.

✅ Try these steps:
1️⃣ Toggle Airplane Mode on/off for 5 seconds, then reconnect.
2️⃣ Disconnect VPN, clear the app cache, and reconnect.
3️⃣ Switch to a *different server* — the current one may be overloaded.
4️⃣ Change tunnel protocol (e.g. SSH → V2Ray or WebSocket).
5️⃣ Check Private DNS: Settings → Network → Private DNS → set to *Off* or *Automatic*, then retry.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[Slow VPN Speed]* ⚡

Slow speeds are usually caused by an overloaded server or a weak signal.

✅ Tips to boost speed:
1️⃣ Switch to a *different server* — choose one with fewer users or closer location.
2️⃣ Toggle Airplane Mode on/off to get a fresh IP and network route.
3️⃣ Make sure you have a strong *4G/LTE signal* — VPN speed depends entirely on your base connection.
4️⃣ Close all background apps using data.
5️⃣ For HTTP Custom & ZiVPN, enable *TCP No Delay* in app settings for a speed boost.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[VPN Blocked on This Network]* 🚫

Some Wi-Fi networks (schools, offices, public hotspots) actively block VPN traffic. This is a network restriction, not an app problem.

✅ Options:
1️⃣ Switch from Wi-Fi to *Mobile Data* — cellular networks rarely block VPNs.
2️⃣ Try changing the tunnel protocol to use *port 443* (HTTPS) — much harder to block.
3️⃣ ZiVPN: try *SSL/Stunnel* or *V2Ray + WebSocket TLS* to disguise traffic as normal HTTPS.
4️⃣ HTTP Custom: adjust your payload to run on port 443.

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[App Update Issue]* 🔄

✅ Steps:
1️⃣ Re-download your config from *www.vpn-config.online* — app updates sometimes require a matching config update.
2️⃣ Clear app cache: Settings → Apps → *[VPN App]* → Storage → *Clear Cache*.
3️⃣ If the new version is very buggy, download a previous stable version from *Uptodown.com*.
4️⃣ Ensure your Android OS is up to date — outdated OS versions can clash with updated apps.

💡 *Quick Fix Tip from Livia AI:*

The fastest first step for almost any VPN issue:

✈️ Toggle *Airplane Mode ON* → wait 5 seconds → toggle *Airplane Mode OFF*

This resets your network connection and gives you a fresh IP address, which instantly fixes the majority of connection errors!

If that doesn't work, send a screenshot of your app log and we'll dig deeper. 🔍

Livia AI Diagnostic: *[VPN Conflict]* ⚠️

Android only allows *one active VPN* at a time. Multiple VPN apps can interfere with each other.

✅ Fix:
1️⃣ Make sure all other VPN apps are *fully disconnected* (not just minimized).
2️⃣ Settings → Network & Internet → VPN → remove any unused old VPN profiles.
3️⃣ Restart your phone to clear lingering VPN sessions, then connect with your preferred app only.
